result.title: World Models, Trees and Foundation Models for Retail Forecasting: Evidence from Four Public Data Sets
result.comment: 37 pages, 18 figures, 26 tables. Code: https://github.com/karthik-iyer-au/retail-world-models, archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.23448056
result.summary: A retailer makes different decisions at different grains of the product, store and time hierarchy: store orders for an item in a store, supplier funding for an item across stores, category performance by store, and the financial plan for the chain. Which forecasting model to use depends on the grain. This paper compares models at each grain on four public data sets (M5, six Dominick's categories, Breakfast at the Frat, and Corporación Favorita, the last kept out of all development), over rolling forecast origins with paired tests and model confidence sets. It covers price and promotion through the plan inputs these data record, not product, assortment or place. The models are a world model that carries each item's state forward under the price and promotion plan, the same network without that state, LightGBM, the Temporal Fusion Transformer, TimesFM, Chronos-Bolt, Timestral, seasonal naive, and an equal-weight average of the world model, LightGBM and TimesFM given the plan. The answer changed with the grain. For an item by store and an item across stores, the average had the lowest error on seven and eight of nine data sets, and the 90% confidence set held a median of 1 and 2 models. For a category by store, a category and the chain total, the lowest-error model differed between data sets and a median of 4 of nine models were not separated by the four to six windows available. For category-by-store planning cost, the average or LightGBM was lowest on seven of eight data sets, and the world model was lowest only on M5; it was behind LightGBM item by store on six of eight. Every trained model used the plan, and on the weekly promotion-driven data pretrained models were less accurate without it. These results hold for these data sets; a forecast solved across all four Ps, or a retailer's own data, may give different results. Every model, test and change that lost is reported.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在四个公开零售数据集上做滚动起点预测，比较「在价格与促销计划下推进商品状态」的世界模型、去掉该状态的同构网络、LightGBM、TFT、TimesFM、Chronos-Bolt 等模型商品-门店、品类、连锁等不同粒度的误差，并用配对检验与模型置信集给出结论，最优模型随粒度与数据而变。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其「带状态世界模型 vs 同结构无状态网络」的消融可能可供核查显式状态推进是否真带来增益，其配对检验与模型置信集的比较方式对 latent 推理的收益与评价也有借鉴可能。
